title: account-routing workspaces.json
description: Per-workspace Google account bindings for the account routing guard.

workspaces.description: Map of workspace root path to its account binding. Longest-prefix match wins.

account.description: The Google account address artifacts from this workspace must use.

label.description: Short workspace name used in block messages. Defaults to the root path.

tool_hint.description: Optional suggestion appended to the block message, e.g. 'calendar-mcp: manage_event'.
